label: AI Verify
description: A reviewer model scores any output (text, image, 3D model) against your criteria and routes it to Pass or Fail. For 3D models it reads the measured mesh facts and the embedded textures.

inputs.name: in
inputs.label: Subject
inputs.description: The thing to verify: text, an image, or a mesh asset.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.label: Criteria
inputs.description: Overrides the configured criteria at runtime.

inputs.name: context
inputs.label: Context
inputs.description: Extra facts for the reviewer: the original brief, a mesh summary, etc.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Preview Image
inputs.description: Optional extra image(s) of the work, e.g. a render of the model.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model Override
inputs.description: Overrides the reviewer model at runtime.

outputs.name: feedback
outputs.label: Feedback
outputs.description: Actionable instructions for the next attempt.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the step failed. Wire it to handle failures yourself; leave it unwired and the node fails visibly instead.

properties.label: Reviewer Model
properties.placeholder: Select a model (vision-capable for images / textures)…

properties.label: Criteria
properties.placeholder: What does a good result look like? e.g. Matches the brief, game-ready, no baked-in lighting, consistent style.
